caustica.options.rt.exposureMode.tooltip: How the ray-traced image is mapped to display brightness. Auto adapts to scene luminance; Manual uses the exposure value directly.
caustica.options.rt.manualEv.tooltip: Exposure compensation in stops. In Manual, this is the fixed exposure. In Auto, this biases the auto exposure brighter or darker.
caustica.options.rt.gamma.tooltip: Post-transform luminance gamma. Values below 1.00 brighten shadows and midtones while preserving black, white, and color ratios.
caustica.options.rt.spp.tooltip: Path-tracing samples taken per pixel each frame. Higher is cleaner but more demanding.
caustica.options.rt.maxBounces.tooltip: Maximum number of secondary path-tracing bounces after the primary hit. Higher captures more indirect light but costs more.
caustica.options.rt.entities.tooltip: Include entities and block entities in the ray-traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.particles.tooltip: Draw particles as camera-ray billboards inside the traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.glow.tooltip: Draw the vanilla Glowing-effect outline (through walls) around glowing entities.
caustica.options.rt.waterWaves.tooltip: Animate water-surface normals for moving wave highlights.
caustica.options.rt.volumetricFog.toolti: Enable deterministic, ray-traced camera-frustum fog. It is rebuilt every frame without temporal history and disabled while submerged.
caustica.options.rt.fogQuality.tooltip: Froxel resolution. High is exactly 128 x 64 x 128; Medium and Low cover the same frustum with fewer cells.
caustica.options.rt.fogDensity.tooltip: Neutral Beer-Lambert extinction per block. Higher values attenuate distant surfaces and make in-scattering denser.
caustica.options.rt.fogDistance.tooltip: Physical distance covered by the camera frustum volume. At High, 128 blocks and a linear distribution average one block per depth slice.
caustica.options.rt.fogDepthDistribution: 1.00 gives linear one-block-scale depth at the default High grid. Larger values concentrate slices near the camera.
caustica.options.rt.fogAlbedo.tooltip: Neutral fraction of extinction that scatters light instead of absorbing it.
caustica.options.rt.fogHeightOffset.tool: Reference altitude relative to sea level where the configured extinction applies.
caustica.options.rt.fogHeightFalloff.too: Exponential reduction of density above the reference height. Zero produces uniform-height fog.
caustica.options.rt.fogNoiseAmount.toolt: Strength of static world-space fBm density modulation. It has no wind or time animation.
caustica.options.rt.fogNoiseScale.toolti: World-space fBm frequency per block. Larger values create smaller density features.
caustica.options.rt.fogAmbientStrength.t: Broad atmosphere-LUT sky illumination in the medium, conservatively masked in caves.
caustica.options.rt.lightShaftStrength.t: Strength of ray-traced sun and moon in-scattering without changing density or surface lighting.
caustica.options.rt.lightShaftFocus.tool: Normalized Henyey-Greenstein anisotropy for sun and moon. Positive values focus forward scattering; negative values focus backward scattering.
caustica.options.rt.localFogStrength.too: Strength of colored mist around bounded block-emitter area lights.
caustica.options.rt.localFogFocus.toolti: Normalized Henyey-Greenstein anisotropy for local block emitters.
caustica.options.rt.localFogCandidates.t: Nearby light proposals considered per froxel. Zero disables emissive mist; higher values reduce selection noise but cost GPU time.
caustica.options.rt.localFogSamples.tool: Independent deterministic local-light estimates per froxel. Higher values improve colored mist stability and are demanding.
caustica.options.rt.localFogClamp.toolti: Maximum local-emitter source luminance stored in a froxel. Lower values suppress isolated fireflies more aggressively.
caustica.options.rt.fogFilterEdges.toolt: How strongly the spatial filter rejects different extinction values. Higher values preserve density edges and reduce light leaking.
caustica.options.rt.hdr.tooltip: Recreate the swapchain for HDR (ST.2084/PQ) or native SDR output. Applied at the next frame boundary.
caustica.options.rt.hdrUiBrightness.tool: Absolute brightness (in nits) assigned to SDR-authored UI on an HDR display.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPeak.tooltip: Absolute brightness (in nits) highlights roll off toward. Set to your display's peak HDR brightness.
caustica.options.rt.dlssQuality.tooltip: DLSS Ray Reconstruction quality mode. Lower-quality modes render fewer pixels and upscale more aggressively for higher framerates; higher-quality modes render more pixels for a sharper image. Only affects the image when DLSS Ray Reconstruction is enabled.
caustica.options.rt.debugView.tooltip: Inspect ray-tracing buffers and exposure diagnostics after the normal frame has rendered.
